title: Migrate per-changed-column audit event emission
target_requirement: Reimplement the legacy audit writer as emit_audits(table, old, new, user, ts) -> list[event]: one event per changed audited column (audited set baked in from audit_config.cfg), events ordered by the config's file order for that table, event fields named after the AUD_EVENT schema (EVT_TS, EVT_CD='COL_UPD', USR_ID, ENT_NAME, ENT_ID from the table's primary key, OLD_VAL, NEW_VAL stringified).
expected_behavior: Changing one audited column emits exactly one correctly shaped event; multiple changes emit in config file order; unchanged audited columns, changed unaudited columns, and unaudited tables emit nothing; numeric values are stringified and None/missing become empty strings; injected ts and user pass through verbatim; behavior matches a fresh in-test parse of the legacy config for every table.
provenance: Synthetic; authored for LegacyCRM-Bench from Meridian CRM 4.2 spec (SYSTEM_OVERVIEW.md §8).
security_expectations: Audit coverage must not be silently narrowed or widened: events are emitted for exactly the columns listed in the legacy configuration, no more and no fewer. No wall-clock reads; no network or subprocess imports.
failure_conditions: Emitting one event per update instead of per changed column; wrong event ordering; auditing unlisted columns or skipping listed ones; reading the system clock; nondeterminism; network access.
